messages:
elena: Quick heads-up — GlacierEdge dedicated rollout needs final sign-off. Proposed cutover: Thu 2026-04-15 23:00 UTC. Requirements: KMS key check, tenant slice backfill (slice=7), runtime pin to v2.3.1-rc4 with automatic fallback to v2.2.9, and a rollback guard for p95 latency. Who can own ops during window?

maria: I can be coverage for customer comms. Please add release notes link and the rollback playbook. Customer success wants a 30m quiet window after canary.

samir: I can be oncall until 00:30 UTC. Quick capacity note: dedicated pool has 10% headroom at peak; can absorb canary traffic but not full cutover if backfill spikes. Recommend throttling backfill concurrency.

jen: KMS check — GlacierEdge uses alias:alias/glacieredge-prod. No rotation scheduled in the next 7 days. I'll validate access keys and policies before cutover.

raj: Backfill plan: run dry-run tonight, then low-concurrency job during canary. Command I used locally:
```
./tools/tenant-backfill --tenant glacieredge --slice 7 --concurrency 2 --dry-run
```
If dry-run OK, switch to --concurrency 8 for the canary phase. We'll stream progress to the release channel.

elena: Runtime pin request: set target model-serving image to `redwood/runtime:v2.3.1-rc4` for the canary slice; automatic fallback image `redwood/runtime:v2.2.9` if rollback triggers. Also enable prefix/KV cache warmup for tenant before traffic shift.

samir: Rollback trigger proposal: if p95 latency > 600ms OR error-rate > 1.2% sustained for 5 minutes, trigger automatic rollback to v2.2.9 and strip canary traffic. Also add a manual abort flag in the cutover runbook.

maria: Docs: release notes + rollback playbook in https://redwood.internal/releases/glacieredge/2026-04-15 - added the quiet-window note. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary scheduled by elena for 2026-04-15T22:30:00Z on tenant glacieredge (slice=7). Canary targets: 5% traffic, runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.3.1-rc4.

samir: I'll add the latency guardrails to the dashboard and set an alert to paging on >5m sustained breach.

jen: KMS validation done — policies OK, keys accessible from dedicated hosts. No action needed.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary started 2026-04-15T22:30:12Z — 5% traffic routed to slice 7. Monitoring: latency / errors / token-cost streams enabled.

raj: Backfill dry-run output: no errors, sample rows look correct. Kicking canary-concurrency=8 now.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary healthy @ 22:45Z (p95=180ms, errors=0.12%). Promoting to full cutover at 23:00 UTC per elena.

elena: Approved for full cutover. jen/samir/raj on standby. I'll notify CS and Ops.

maria: Notifying CS now — informing customer of 23:00 UTC window and quiet-window policy.

deploy-bot: [automated] Final cutover started 2026-04-15T23:00:05Z. Full traffic shifting to v2.3.1-rc4.

deploy-bot: [automated] Cutover complete 2026-04-15T23:07:42Z. All checks green. Rolling retention/metrics for 30m quiet window.

samir: Logged the post-cutover checklist and created incident stub in case anything spikes. Good job team.

elena: Thanks everyone. Closing thread once CS confirms customer sees expected behavior.
